rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child. Both are Kennedy letters transmitting District of Columbia voting legislation, and they share the distinctive principle that government must be responsible to the governed, describe voting as a basic right of District residents shared with other Americans, request prompt favorable congressional action, and use nearly identical enclosure language concerning a detailed letter from the President of the District Board of Commissioners. C15 and C04 have similar transmission, enclosure, counterpart-letter, and favorable-action structures, but lack C16's unusually close subject matter and substantive language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: restore to District residents the basic right to local self-government through the elective process, a right enjoyed by all other American citizens
shared_material.parent_excerpt: permit the greatest possible number of citizens of the District of Columbia to share with their fellow Americans the basic right to vote
shared_material.explanation: Both frame District suffrage as a basic right that its residents should share with other Americans.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to reaffirm our belief in the principle that government should be responsible to the governed
shared_material.parent_excerpt: reaffirms the belief of the people of the entire Nation in the basic principle that government must be responsible to those governed
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive, nearly verbatim statement of the governing principle.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In addition to the draft bill, I am enclosing a letter from the President of the Board of Commissioners to the District of Columbia, describing the legislation in some detail.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In addition to the draft bill, I am enclosing a letter from the President of the Board of Commissioners of the District of Columbia describing this legislation in detail.
shared_material.explanation: The same enclosure and explanatory machinery appears in almost identical language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope therefore that early hearings can be held and that favorable action will be taken by the Congress
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that prompt and favorable action will be taken by the Congress on the proposed legislation
shared_material.explanation: The closing request follows the same operative formulation.
